ValidationRule.description: When Salesforce Field Resource = "Resource", make Dispatch Region mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.NSP_UserValidations__c != True, OR(ISPICKVAL( NSP_Salesforce_Field_Service__c , 'Resource'), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Salesforce_Field_Service__c , 'Dispatcher + Resource')), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Dispatch_Region__c, '' ) )
